coach_says: TSB is a brutal -55.5 and Garmin flags UNPRODUCTIVE — this is a mandatory recovery week: one quality session maximum, everything else easy or rest. The committed Tuesday hard MTB group ride is that one quality session; everything around it must be low-stress. Aerobic high shortage is noted but cannot be addressed this week — restoring TSB takes priority, and anaerobic load is already well above target so no extra hard efforts.

days.details:
Workout A:
Bench press 3x(15-18 / 12-15 / 8-12)
Lat pulldown 3x(15-18 / 12-15 / 8-12)
Romanian DL 3x(15-18 / 12-15 / 8-12)
Single-leg press 3x(15-18 / 12-15 / 8-12)
Plank 3x45 sec

Perform 3 sets of each exercise. Rep ranges progress across sets: 1st set 15-18 reps, 2nd set 12-15 reps, 3rd set 8-12 reps. Keep loads light — this is a recovery stimulus, not a strength push. Rest 60-90 sec between sets.

Tuesday evening hard MTB group ride — non-negotiable committed session. This is the single quality session for the recovery week. Ride at group pace, no extra efforts beyond what the ride demands. If a morning road ride also happens today, treat it as easy spinning only (zone 1-2, 45-60 min) to preserve something for the evening group ride.
Complete rest day. Mandatory recovery from Tuesday's hard effort. No exceptions — no easy spin, no stretching session that creeps into moderate effort. Eat well, hydrate, sleep.

45 min easy road spin — zone 1-2 only (RPE 2-3). Flat or gently rolling route. 10 min warmup, 25 min steady easy cadence (90+ rpm encouraged), 10 min cooldown. No surges, no climbs that push HR. Purpose is blood flow and leg flush, not training stimulus.

45 min yoga focused on hip flexors, hamstrings, thoracic spine, and glutes. Suggested sequence: cat-cow, pigeon pose, lizard lunge, supine twist, downward dog, child's pose. Move slowly and breathe — no hot yoga or power yoga this week. This supports hip stability and mobility that feeds back into cycling mechanics.

75 min easy road or gravel ride — zone 2 only (RPE 3-4, conversational pace). Flat to rolling terrain. 10 min warmup zone 1, 55 min steady zone 2, 10 min cooldown zone 1. Keep HR below threshold at all times. Longer is fine only if you feel genuinely good — cap at 90 min and stay in zone 2. No intervals, no chasing.

Warmup: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 4x150m (first 50m easy / next 100m strong pace), 20 sec rest
Cooldown: 100m backstroke or easy choice
Total: ~1000m

Note: This week keep the main sets at easy-to-moderate effort only — treat the entire swim as recovery. Focus on technique and breathing rhythm rather than pace.
